title: Onion-DDD audit rubric
description: Pattern-based rubric for the onion-tdd-strict audit lens. Each rule's `pattern` is run as grep (or ast-grep for `lang:` rules) over `globs`; matches surface as findings with the rule's `severity` + `fix_shape`.

severity.description: P0 architectural, P1 boundary leak, P2 smell, P3 cosmetic.

layer.description: Which layer the rule guards. Determines where the violation lives.

pattern.description: Regex (Python `re`) matched against each line in matching files. Use ast-grep via the separate `lang` form for AST-level patterns (not in scope here).

globs.description: Path globs (Path.rglob-style) where the rule applies. Restrict to the layer the rule guards.

exclude_globs.description: Paths to ignore even if they match `globs` (e.g. composition root for the composition-root-scattered rule).

fix_shape.description: One-sentence remediation shape — the fix idea, not the full plan.
